purpose: Observe and isolate one explicitly selected paired-entry extraction; not DB BLAST, all-entry enumeration or an integrated-capability claim.
before_execution_requirements: Root explicitly selects this concrete proposed native invocation and its resource binding.
Use existing child-owned native lifecycle inside bounded529 with 20 GiB RAM, 4 GiB scratch, swap zero and wall time unset.
Pin strace, bwrap, helper, selected loader cache, ELF interpreter/libraries and any separately selected runtime dependency before execution; preserve original paths and namespace path mapping.

Declare exact file read allowlist from before-pinned runtime dependencies plus the archive, offline.kfg and explicitly permitted proc/dev system interfaces. Broad library mounts are visibility only, not authorization to read arbitrary scientific data.
Create fresh empty work, work/cache and tmp within the future attempt; keep native and tracer output beneath the same scratch-accounted attempt; close unrelated inherited descriptors.
Retain exact applied environment/argv/cwd and complete producer-managed stdout/stderr; verify all original fixture/config pins before and after.
required_actual_evidence: Complete full-syscall trace covers successful helper exec and every descendant/thread until terminal closure, without detach/error/lost or truncated trace.
Trace shows successful creation/inheritance of a separate network namespace; namespace failure remains a failed attempt and does not trigger a host-network fallback.
No successful network-content receive/read or undeclared socket/IPC content; retain failed network attempts distinctly.

Every successful file content read and file-backed mmap is tied to its original open/descriptor/path and declared before-pin; no undeclared data, schema, user/site config, reference or VDB cache is accepted.
Trace identifies reading the exact mounted offline.kfg; its mere presence or environment declaration is insufficient.
Retain and classify all new work/tmp files; they begin empty, remain inside recorded scratch and cannot contain inherited content.
Returned table has the exact requested two native IDs and its sequence bytes/lengths agree with the independent companion first pair before creating native identity bindings.
limits: Facility presence and readable local manuals do not establish namespace or ptrace permission.
Current kernel AppArmor unprivileged-userns restriction is 1; actual bwrap success remains unknown.
ELF/native schema closure for this helper is not established by acquisition; an unexpected dependency is a specific unresolved result, not authority to acquire or mount it.
The proposed library directory mounts expose more files than the exact runtime allowlist; trace analysis must reject undeclared reads rather than inferring closure from mount success.
This proposal supplies an observation/isolation mechanism, not an implemented utility integration or VDB_OFFLINE_BINDING.json.
